```{r setup-vis, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
library(MASS)
library(caret)
library(modelsummary)

data <- readr::read_delim("housing-prices-ge19.txt", delim = "\t")

data_transformed <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Price), Price > 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Price_1K      = Price / 1000,
    log_price     = log(Price),
    Waterfront    = as.factor(Waterfront),
    Central.Air   = as.factor(Central.Air),
    New.Construct = as.factor(New.Construct)
  )


full <- lm(Price ~ Living.Area + Land.Value + Age + Bathrooms + Rooms +
             Fireplaces + Pct.College + Waterfront, data = data_transformed)

null <- lm(Price ~ 1, data = data_transformed)

step.fwd.aic  <- stepAIC(null,
                         scope = list(lower = formula(null), upper = formula(full)),
                         direction = "forward", trace = FALSE)
step.back.aic <- stepAIC(full, direction = "backward", trace = FALSE)

modelsummary::modelsummary(
  list("Forward model" = step.fwd.aic,
       "Backward model" = step.back.aic),
  output = "html",
  estimate = "{estimate}",           
  statistic = "p.value",             
  statistic_rename = c("p.value"="p"),
  gof_omit = "IC|Log.Lik",
  fmt = 2,                           
  shape = term ~ model + statistic   
)


```
```{r}
set.seed(1)

train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

cv_model <- train(
  Price ~ Living.Area + Land.Value + Age + Bathrooms + Rooms +
           Fireplaces + Pct.College + Waterfront,
  data = data_transformed,
  method = "lm",
  trControl = train_control
)

print(cv_model)
```

```{r exhaustive-leaps, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaps)
# choose a clean numeric set (factors → numeric so regsubsets behaves)
df_leaps <- data_transformed |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    log_price,
    Living.Area, Land.Value, Age, Bathrooms, Rooms, Fireplaces, Pct.College,
    Waterfront = as.integer(Waterfront) - 1  # 0/1
  )

preds <- setdiff(names(df_leaps), "log_price")
form  <- as.formula(paste("log_price ~", paste(preds, collapse = " + ")))

exh <- regsubsets(form, data = df_leaps,
                  nvmax = length(preds), method = "exhaustive")
exh_sum <- summary(exh)

# Which model size is best by BIC?
best_row <- which.min(exh_sum$bic)
best_vars <- names(which(exh_sum$which[best_row,]))   # includes "(Intercept)"
best_vars <- setdiff(best_vars, "(Intercept)")

cat("Best (by BIC): ", paste(best_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")

```
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
op <- par(mar = c(5, 10, 3, 2) + 0.1, xpd = NA)
plot(exh, scale = "bic")

usr <- par("usr")
rect(usr[1] - 0.12*(usr[2]-usr[1]), usr[3], usr[1] + 0.005*(usr[2]-usr[1]), usr[4],
     col = "white", border = NA)

yy   <- seq_len(nrow(exh_sum$which))
labs <- sprintf("%.2f", exh_sum$bic)

mtext(labs, side = 2, at = yy, line = 0.8, las = 1, cex = 0.9) 
mtext("BIC",  side = 2, line = 4)  

par(op)
```


```{r leaps-heatmap-clean, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# predictors used in the exhaustive search
preds <- setdiff(names(df_leaps), "log_price")

# inclusion matrix -> long format
inc_mat <- as.data.frame(exh_sum$outmat)[, preds, drop = FALSE] |>
  mutate(model = dplyr::row_number(),  # model index
         bic   = exh_sum$bic)

inc_long <- inc_mat |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(preds), names_to = "predictor", values_to = "inc") |>
  mutate(included = as.integer(inc == "*"))

# order rows by BIC (best first) and predictors by inclusion frequency
row_order <- inc_long |>
  distinct(model, bic) |>
  arrange(bic) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number())

pred_order <- inc_long |>
  group_by(predictor) |>
  summarise(freq = sum(included), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(freq)) |>
  pull(predictor)

inc_long2 <- inc_long |>
  left_join(row_order, by = "model") |>
  mutate(predictor = factor(predictor, levels = pred_order))

ggplot(inc_long2, aes(x = predictor, y = rank, fill = factor(included))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "grey90", "1" = "#1f77b4"),
    breaks = c("1","0"),
    labels = c("Included","Excluded")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Exhaustive subset selection (BIC)",
       x = NULL, y = "Models (best BIC at top)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave("exhaustive_heatmap.png", width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```


```{r}
final_model <- step.fwd.aic   # or step.back.aic, whichever you choose

# 1. Check Regression Assumptions
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(final_model)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

# 2. VIF - Multicollinearity Check
library(car)
vif(final_model)

# 3. Histogram of Residuals
hist(residuals(final_model), main = "Residual Distribution", xlab = "Residuals")

```
```{r corr-heatmap, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1) Pick numeric variables to include
num_df <- data_transformed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Price, log_price, Living.Area, Land.Value, Age, Bathrooms,
    Rooms, Fireplaces, Pct.College, Lot.Size
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# 2) Correlation matrix (Pearson). Use method="spearman" if you prefer ranks.
C <- cor(num_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

# 3) Reorder rows/cols by hierarchical clustering on |cor|
ord <- hclust(as.dist(1 - abs(C)))$order
C   <- C[ord, ord]

# 4) Long format for ggplot
corr_long <- as.data.frame(C) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Var1, names_to = "Var2", values_to = "corr")

# 5) Plot
ggplot(corr_long, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = corr)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1), midpoint = 0,
                       low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       name = "Correlation") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Correlation Heatmap",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

```
